# Lot — inventory ageing and price decay

> A used-car dealer's dashboard: what each unsold vehicle is costing in carrying charges,
> how long it has sat, and how far its asking price has fallen since it was listed. Built
> for the ALBA CARS engineering assessment.

Everything except the sign-in page is behind authentication, and each dealer can read only
their own rows. There is nothing here to crawl.

## Pages

- [Sign in](https://alba-lot-dashboard.vercel.app/sign-in): the only publicly reachable page.

## Source and documentation

- [Repository](https://github.com/novaxertz/alba-cars-assessment): all three assessment projects.
- [README](https://github.com/novaxertz/alba-cars-assessment/blob/main/02-dashboard/README.md): data model, security boundary, how to run it.
- [Build log](https://github.com/novaxertz/alba-cars-assessment/blob/main/02-dashboard/BUILD_LOG.md): decisions, bugs and known limitations.
